install.label: Install PrediGol
install.hint: Open it like an app, full screen
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad, in Safari: tap Share, scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”. If you see “Open as Web App”, leave it on and tap “Add”.
install.android: On Android, in Chrome: tap More (⋮) next to the address bar and choose “Install” (or “Add to Home screen”).
install.other: On a computer, in Chrome or Edge: use the install icon in the address bar.
install.after: Once installed it opens from its icon, full screen, with the same account. It updates itself: when there is a new version, PrediGol tells you.
